verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Skills are uploaded and run through Anthropic's hosted services (Claude.ai, the Skills API and workspaces), so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is used for model training. The evidence pack covers only skill authoring, invocation, plugins, marketplaces and the Agent SDK. It contains nothing about data-use or training policy, opt-out controls, or retention, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
